hooks.name: spec-sync
hooks.description: After the agent stops, tick completed task checkboxes in tasks.md.

action.prompt: Review the work completed in this session. Open .kiro/specs/dead-phone-directory/tasks.md and tick the checkbox (change `- [ ]` to `- [x]`) for every sub-item that is now fully implemented and verified. Only tick items that are genuinely done: do not tick items that are partially complete or not yet started. Save the file if you make any changes.
